body:
A strict diameter replacement need not decrease every original pair distance. This change proves an exact obstruction for connected unit-rhombus meshes and a quantitative requirement for a whole-source improvement: reaching diameter at most 2(R-1) in the specified radius-R mesh requires local lengths to grow on at least ceil(R/8) cells and ceil(R/16) distinct pairs.

The report supplies complete finite endpoint proofs, without an interpolation or infinitesimal-motion assumption. An unbounded triangle-free family approaches triangular packing density, includes an off-lattice contact isolate, and resists every pairwise nonexpanding strict endpoint; elementary lattice averaging nevertheless gives a same-cardinality strict independent competitor. These are rigorously nonglobal regressions. The linear growth bound is not asserted for every arbitrarily small strict improvement.

All new claims remain unreviewed proved candidates/regressions pending independent mathematical scrutiny. Please audit the circle-selection and antipodal-shadow argument in Theorem 3, the adjacent-cell gluing in Theorem 1, and the source/replacement count in Theorem 2. This PR is not a promotion. Level I, A, B and C-II remain open; canonical theorem state and active prompts are unchanged.

Canonical baseline: ab6dd3336f9f8d440f2bada76edb32153391cddc, state 2026-10-10.audit.234, seed 54 (Global diameter competitors and extremal geometry). The canonical population-reserve and source-payment theorems motivate the attack but are not premises of the new proof. New proofs use only elementary geometry, convexity, and lattice tiling/averaging; no external theorem is imported. No stress, ZR/ZF full-source extension, fixed-wall capacity, or global-optimality hypothesis is inferred from the fixtures.

Validation:

- Two separate integer/rational engines pass at 1,893 / 13,141 / 5,259 / 66,657 full source labels. Every fixture includes the isolate and an equal-cardinality strict replacement.
- The Cartesian engine directly enumerates every source and replacement pair in the two smaller fixtures. The larger complete pair ledgers use exact integral norm classification and convex-hull extremality; quadratic enumeration of those ledgers is not claimed.
- Actual squared-diameter reductions are 2420 -> 2116, 16724 -> 15876, 6636 -> 6084, and 83776 -> 81796. Both engines independently check bad-cell counts for an actual endpoint labeling.
- Five negative/scope controls exercise omitted diagonal constraints, omitted lower separation, disconnected meshes, triangular-limit contact parity, and strict comparison margins.
- Artifact index/header regenerated; theorem-state and PR-state checks pass; all 22 theorem-tooling tests pass; relative report links and full PR whitespace checks pass.

Reproduction and exact coordinate-index hashes are in research/seed054_rhombus_mesh_certificate.json and the dated report. Finite checks do not establish the infinite claims; their complete analytic proofs are supplied separately.

AI disclosure: mathematics, implementation, and self-scrutiny were performed by OpenAI Codex in this autonomous run. Separate verification implementations are not represented as independent human review.

title: Finite diameter improvement requires linear local growth in rhombus meshes
